business.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01) 的 patch 与 Skill 相对手工 MCP 连接：workflow 9 超过 0，集中配置和操作指引带来局部便利，未证重要分工变化不足 18；delivery 0 因结果仍由原后端产生，未见新增交付单位；reach 5 超过 0，给已有 DSH 用户提供有限入口，但没证明新的受限人群进入，不足 10；economics 0 因未见资源组织或收费改变，不把未测节时记为 4。

recommendation.reason: 已有 AItelier 服务且使用 DSH 的操作者可以先研究该 MCP 接入配置。它预置连接和操作指南，但实际工具可用性与权限配置仍需核对。若后端授权、网络或运行状态不明，应停止写操作并检查服务。

data.reports:
# dsh-plugin-aitelier > 将 AItelier 的 MCP 流水线接口接入 DeepSeek Harness。 ## 研究范围 - **仓库**：[linxuhao/AItelier](https://github.com/linxuhao/AItelier) - **版本号**：0.1.9（[固定提交 f1a1413c7fc9f9b4381589ccfcc361e18e0fb7de](https://github.com/linxuhao/AItelier/tree/f1a1413c7fc9f9b4381589ccfcc361e18e0fb7de)） - **版本日期**：2026-11-04（固定提交日期，北京时间；不是包发布日期） ## 结论状态 定向检查固定客户端配置和同仓后端授权源码，未执行宿主或网络请求。 ## 洞察短评 - **用途**：使用 DSH 且已有 AItelier 后端的操作者，希望从会话中操作或观察流水线。 - **亮点**：[Q01](#research-q01) 与 [Q02](#research-q02) 提供预设接线与流程指南；流水线执行本身属于后端。 - **思考**：[Q03](#research-q03) 后端未启用 Cloudflare Access gate 时直接放过写入，不能无条件把无 token 当只读。 - **建议**：[Q05](#research-q05) 假设显示握手和实际授权状态能减少诊断误判，需与现有检查对照。 采用建议：[Q04](#research-q04) 先隔离后端并验证 gate、凭据和工具；权限或后台状态不明时停止写入。 ## 核心贡献 [Q01](#research-q01) 与 [Q02](#research-q02) 提供预设接线与流程指南；流水线执行本身属于后端。 ## 关键质疑 [Q03](#research-q03) 后端未启用 Cloudflare Access gate 时直接放过写入，不能无条件把无 token 当只读。 ## 重点创新推演与最小验证 [Q05](#research-q05) 假设显示握手和实际授权状态能减少诊断误判，需与现有检查对照。 在隔离宿主覆盖握手、故障、gate 开关、不同身份与任务取消；本轮未执行。 ## 场景与替代办法 使用 DSH 且已有 AItelier 后端的操作者，希望从会话中操作或观察流水线。 直接手动配置 DSH MCP client，并自行参考后端接口文档。 ## 依赖与流程 | 依赖 | 条件 | 用途 | 缺失影响 | |---|---|---|---| | DSH 与兼容 mcp-client | 必需 | 挂载 MCP 工具 | 不能使用工具 | | AItelier 服务与模型 | 执行需要 | 流水线与生成 | 后端不可达或任务失败 | | 授权配置与凭据 | 按部署需要 | 限制写和私有读取 | gate 关闭可能放行 | | 存储、日志与备份 | 持续运营需要 | 状态和恢复 | 错误或丢失难以恢复 | | 步骤 | 执行者与动作 | 判据或失败处理 | |---|---|---| | 准备 | 维护者隔离后端并核查实际授权 | 无法确认则停止 | | 连接 | 配置 DSH profile 与可信 URL | 核对握手及工具列表 | | 操作 | 用户核对读写权限后启动任务 | 等待超时先查后台状态 | | 恢复 | 停止或检查运行并恢复备份 | 不确定时暂停写入 | ## 成本与效果 | 阶段 | 资源 | 人工 | 未知 | |---|---|---|---| | 首次 | 宿主、服务、凭据 | 配置和授权审查 | 兼容未知 | | 持续 | 容器与模型调用 | 检查任务、checkpoint 和数据 | 费用未知 | | 恢复 | 后端状态及备份 | 诊断超时与未完成任务 | 恢复未测 | | 结果 | 依据 | 未知 | |---|---|---| | 客户端预设 | patch 行与变量 | 实际加载和省时 | | 工作流指南 | 随包 Skill 文本 | 用户遵循与任务质量 | | 后端授权 | gate 与工具分类 | 实际部署网络保护 | ## 研究问题与完整回答 **插件研究总目标**：核查 DSH MCP bundle 的连接、权限和后端依赖。 ### Q01 · 该 DSH 集成对 AItelier 用户提供什么，相对直接 MCP 接入有什么增量？ **研究主题**：场景与需求、贡献与相对优势 #### 完整回答 这是 DSH Profile Bundle 而非 AItelier 后端本身。它提供一个 MCP 客户端配置和随包使用指南，把单独运行的 AItelier 工具接入 DSH；相比手工添加相同 MCP client，增量是预置端点、凭据引用、超时和具体工作流程说明。后端的 pipeline、State DAG 和模型能力属于 AItelier，不能归功于此 bundle，也不能由声明推断工具实际出现在目标宿主。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 源码核查**：[integrations/dsh/package.json:1-8](https://github.com/linxuhao/AItelier/blob/f1a1413c7fc9f9b4381589ccfcc361e18e0fb7de/integrations/dsh/package.json#L1-L8) 包描述及仅客户端定位。 ```text { "name": "dsh-plugin-aitelier", "version": "0.1.9", "description": "Use AItelier as a subagent from DeepSeek Harness: generate, edit, run, export and import SkillFlow pipelines. Client only \u2014 requires a running AItelier backend (Docker; see README).", "keywords": [ "aitelier", "dsh-plugin", "dsh-skill", ``` **依据 2 · 作者声明**：[integrations/dsh/README.md:1-7](https://github.com/linxuhao/AItelier/blob/f1a1413c7fc9f9b4381589ccfcc361e18e0fb7de/integrations/dsh/README.md#L1-L7) 作者的 Profile Bundle 描述。 ```text # dsh-plugin-aitelier Use **AItelier** as a subagent from [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness): design a pipeline, edit its graph / roles / prompts / tools, run it, and carry it to another machine. The plugin is a Profile Bundle that mounts one `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` row against AItelier's MCP endpoint. The model then sees the surface as native tools under `mcp__aitelier__*`. Compatibility: the patch assumes `dsh-mcp-client`'s config shape as of dsh **0.1.0-rc.2** (`serverName`/`transport`/`url`/`headers`/`toolCallTimeoutMs`); every dsh release through 0.1.2-alpha.1 keeps it. This is deliberately **not** a `peerDependencies` entry: the plugin has no code and imports nothing — dsh resolves the `mcp-client` name from its own installation — and a declared peer would invite pnpm's `auto-install-peers` to pull a second, registry-sourced copy of `dsh-mcp-client` into the profile, which dsh's profile-first module resolution would then shadow the installation's instance with. ``` **依据 3 · 源码核查**：[integrations/dsh/cordis.patch.yml:24-41](https://github.com/linxuhao/AItelier/blob/f1a1413c7fc9f9b4381589ccfcc361e18e0fb7de/integrations/dsh/cordis.patch.yml#L24-L41) 固定客户端、端点及凭据。
查看原文（18行） ```text - insert: - id: mcp-aitelier name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client' config: serverName: aitelier transport: streamable-http url: !!js process.env.AITELIER_MCP_URL || 'http://127.0.0.1:4444/mcp' headers: X-AItelier-Admin-Token: !!js process.env.AITELIER_ADMIN_TOKEN || '' X-AItelier-Driver-Token: !!js process.env.AITELIER_DRIVER_TOKEN || '' # An AItelier run is long and pauses for human approval, so `wait_for_run` # blocks. dsh-mcp-client's own default is 60s, and a wait longer than the # CLIENT's timeout does not wait longer — the client hangs up first and the # model sees a transport error instead of "still running", which reads as a # broken tool rather than a long job. 10 minutes lets one wait_for_run # cover a realistic stretch of a run; every other tool answers in # milliseconds, so raising this costs nothing when nothing is wrong. toolCallTimeoutMs: !!js Number(process.env.AITELIER_MCP_TIMEOUT_MS || 600000) ```
**依据 4 · 源码核查**：[integrations/dsh/skills/aitelier-pipelines/SKILL.md:8-22](https://github.com/linxuhao/AItelier/blob/f1a1413c7fc9f9b4381589ccfcc361e18e0fb7de/integrations/dsh/skills/aitelier-pipelines/SKILL.md#L8-L22) 指南要求先读取活契约并区分完成与验收。
查看原文（15行） ```text ## Persistent project State DAG For project goals and acceptance, first call `state_graph_help` and read its `driver_guide` field. It is the tool-only fallback for the MCP prompt `state_graph_driver` and resource `aitelier://state/driver-guide`; use the live schemas instead of assuming this client bundles the latest server contract. If State tools are absent, report the backend capability gap; ordinary pipeline operations can still be used where appropriate. Use one persistent State project per product. Register workflow or external attempts before dispatch, retain exact IDs and frozen context, and wait with `state_graph_read(action="wait_for_state_change", arguments=...)`. Persist `next_after` with its filter scope. Timeout does not stop a worker; completion produces a candidate, not acceptance. Record actual evidence for each criterion before explicit verification. Checkpoint decisions follow existing authorization. ```
#### 缺口 - 未比较实际用户手工配置与宿主使用 **影响**：不能量化接入便利及实际工具可用 **进一步探讨**：对照相同后端手配和 bundle 的发现、失败与配置步骤。 ### Q02 · 配置如何连接后端，失败和长等待有什么边界？ **研究主题**：功能与机制、工程质量与复用 #### 完整回答 patch 插入 dsh-mcp-client 行，serverName 为 aitelier、transport 为 streamable-http，默认本机 4444 的 /mcp，URL 与两种 token 从环境读取，调用超时默认 600000ms。README 表示宿主默认启动失败不阻断、工具可能静默缺席，但该默认属于外部 DSH 版本行为，本次未核实宿主源码；超时只约束客户端等待，不能证明服务端任务终止，指南明确超时不停止工作者。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 源码核查**：[integrations/dsh/cordis.patch.yml:24-48](https://github.com/linxuhao/AItelier/blob/f1a1413c7fc9f9b4381589ccfcc361e18e0fb7de/integrations/dsh/cordis.patch.yml#L24-L48) MCP 客户端接线、超时和默认失败注释。
查看原文（25行） ```text - insert: - id: mcp-aitelier name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client' config: serverName: aitelier transport: streamable-http url: !!js process.env.AITELIER_MCP_URL || 'http://127.0.0.1:4444/mcp' headers: X-AItelier-Admin-Token: !!js process.env.AITELIER_ADMIN_TOKEN || '' X-AItelier-Driver-Token: !!js process.env.AITELIER_DRIVER_TOKEN || '' # An AItelier run is long and pauses for human approval, so `wait_for_run` # blocks. dsh-mcp-client's own default is 60s, and a wait longer than the # CLIENT's timeout does not wait longer — the client hangs up first and the # model sees a transport error instead of "still running", which reads as a # broken tool rather than a long job. 10 minutes lets one wait_for_run # cover a realistic stretch of a run; every other tool answers in # milliseconds, so raising this costs nothing when nothing is wrong. toolCallTimeoutMs: !!js Number(process.env.AITELIER_MCP_TIMEOUT_MS || 600000) # Deliberately left at the default (false): a temporarily-down AItelier # must not make `dsh` itself unbootable. The cost is that the failure is # SILENT — no mcp__aitelier__* tools appear and nothing says why. That is # the first thing the README tells you to check, because an agent facing a # missing toolset cannot diagnose it from the inside (verified: it answers # "NONE FOUND" and can only guess at the cause). # failOnStartupError: false ```
**依据 2 · 作者声明**：[integrations/dsh/README.md:9-20](https://github.com/linxuhao/AItelier/blob/f1a1413c7fc9f9b4381589ccfcc361e18e0fb7de/integrations/dsh/README.md#L9-L20) 作者的静默失败诊断与独立后端说明。
查看原文（12行） ```text > ### No `mcp__aitelier__*` tools? Read this first. > > A connection failure here is **silent**. `dsh-mcp-client` has `failOnStartupError: false`, so an unreachable endpoint does not stop `dsh` booting — the tools simply never appear, and nothing says why. An agent in that state can only report "no such tools" and guess; it cannot diagnose it from the inside. Check, in order: > > 1. **Is AItelier running?** `curl -s localhost:4444/health` should answer `{"status":"ok",…}`. If not, start it — see [Prerequisite](#prerequisite-aitelier-itself). > 2. **Is the URL right for where `dsh` runs?** The default is `http://127.0.0.1:4444/mcp` (host). Use `http://aitelier:4444/mcp` **only** if `dsh` is itself a container on the same docker network. > 3. **Does the endpoint answer?** `curl -s -X POST $AITELIER_MCP_URL -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Accept: application/json, text/event-stream' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"initialize","params":{"protocolVersion":"2025-06-18","capabilities":{},"clientInfo":{"name":"c","version":"0"}}}'` — a `421` means the Host header is not in AItelier's allow-list (set `AITELIER_MCP_ALLOWED_HOSTS` on the AItelier side). > 4. **Is the row actually mounted?** `dsh --profile --dump-config | grep -A3 mcp-aitelier`. ## Prerequisite: AItelier itself This plugin is a *client*. It does not install or start AItelier — you need one running and reachable first. AItelier ships as a container: ```
**依据 3 · 源码核查**：[integrations/dsh/skills/aitelier-pipelines/SKILL.md:17-22](https://github.com/linxuhao/AItelier/blob/f1a1413c7fc9f9b4381589ccfcc361e18e0fb7de/integrations/dsh/skills/aitelier-pipelines/SKILL.md#L17-L22) 等待与工作者状态边界。 ```text Use one persistent State project per product.
